systemN.title: System Identifier

systemN.title: System Identifier
systemN.description: Identifier or version number of the system case used by the EMT simulation.

ts.title: Simulation Time Step
ts.description: EMT simulation time step in seconds.

netMod.description: Network equation solution method or implementation mode.

inputSchema.description:
Configuration schema and OEDISI ComponentParameters for model anonymization.

Attributes:
    name: Optional component or scenario name.
    model_dir: Path to OpenDSS model directory.
    master_file: Name of the master DSS file (e.g. 'master.dss' or 'IEEE123Master.dss').
    output_dir: Optional destination directory for anonymized OpenDSS files.
    in_place: Whether to modify source files in place (mutually exclusive with output_dir).
    noise_level: Relative noise level for numerical parameters (default: 0.05 = +/-5%).
    epsilon: Optional Differential Privacy epsilon parameter.
    salt: Salt string for deterministic SHA-256 pseudonymization.
    seed: Optional integer random seed for reproducible noise generation.
    anonymize_names: Whether to pseudonymize bus and element names.
    anonymize_values: Whether to inject noise into physical parameters (kW, kvar, length, etc.).
    anonymize_loadshapes: Whether to pseudonymize and perturb loadshape profiles.
    validate_powerflow: Whether to verify power flow convergence after anonymization.
    save_mapping: Whether to save name_mapping.json containing original-to-anonymized map.

output_dir.description: Output directory for anonymized OpenDSS files
output_dir.title: Output Dir

salt.description: Salt string for deterministic SHA-256 pseudonymization
salt.title: Salt

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible noise generation
seed.title: Seed

validate_powerflow.title: Validate Powerflow

ProfileFilterSpec.description:
Specification for filtering, grouping, and slicing profiles.

Attributes:
    selected_profiles: Optional list of specific profile names or CSV filenames to process.
    group_by: Grouping strategy ('loadshape', 'voltage_class', 'all').
    scaling_factor: Linear multiplier applied to generated profiles.
    clip_negative: Whether to clamp negative values to zero (true for load & solar).
    sample_start_idx: Starting index in profile time-series (default 0).
    sample_length: Number of time steps to extract (if None, extract entire profile).

selected_profiles.description: Optional list of specific profile/loadshape names to process
selected_profiles.title: Selected Profiles

group_by.description: Strategy for grouping load profiles during training
group_by.title: Group By

sample_length.description: Length of profile slice to extract and synthesize (e.g. 96 or 35040)
sample_length.title: Sample Length

ProfileFilterSpec.title: ProfileFilterSpec

SynthesizerSpec.description:
Specification of the SDV synthesizer model and training hyperparameters.

Attributes:
    synthesizer_type: Model type ('PARSynthesizer', 'GaussianCopulaSynthesizer',
        'CTGANSynthesizer', 'TVAESynthesizer').
    epochs: Number of training epochs.
    sequence_length: Length of each sequence slice for sequential synthesizers.
    num_sequences: Number of sequences to sample per profile group (if None, inferred).
    enforce_min_max_values: Clip synthesized values to min/max observed during training.
    verbose: Verbose progress reporting during training.
    cuda: Whether to use CUDA/GPU if available.

num_sequences.description: Number of sequences to sample (inferred from data if omitted)
num_sequences.title: Num Sequences

enforce_min_max_values.description: Enforce min and max bounds from original data
enforce_min_max_values.title: Enforce Min Max Values

cuda.description: Enable CUDA acceleration for neural synthesizers
cuda.title: Cuda
